# Architecture

- ARC-001 (must): Web apps use Clean Architecture in one deployable app; each distinct business area is a module with Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Presentation and Contracts projects, and Application code is grouped by feature; a project can deviate by ADR.
- ARC-002 (must): Modules talk to each other only through their Contracts projects; a module never reads or writes another module's tables, and an app never shares its database with another app.
- ARC-003 (must): Shared libraries (Domain, Application, Contracts, API client, validation, UI-independent presentation logic) reference no UI or platform package.
- ARC-016 (should): ASP.NET Core's built-in use of and support for dependency injection makes Clean Architecture the most appropriate way to structure non-trivial monolithic applications. In it, the Application Core holds the business model, including the interfaces for operations performed using Infrastructure; Infrastructure's services should implement interfaces defined in the Application Core; and the UI project should reference the Application Core project, and its types should interact with infrastructure strictly through interfaces defined in Application Core.
